name: runtime_kernel_refactor
purpose: Generic structural fixture for PIE 0.1 K1-K7 runtime kernel: bounded semantic mutation can still require global surface reconstruction, and every durable candidate rule must trace to the allowed meaning set.
natural_request: 请把这个 ChatGPT Project 的长期 instructions 整理成可以直接替换的完整版本。只做当前必要的长期规则整理；保留已有授权、隐私、安全、证据和事实来源边界；把易变细节放回权威来源；不要顺手增加历史事故、最佳实践或示例清单。

live_setting_facts: Three duplicated answer-delivery sections govern the same normal trigger: conclusion first, user action next, evidence after that.
One distinct closure-report rule applies only when formally closing a delivery task.
Current request asks for a complete replacement and one small locator bridge correction.
expected: Semantic mutation stays bounded to the locator correction.
Surface reconstruction may globally regroup duplicated answer-delivery sections.
Closure-report trigger remains distinct when needed.
Old heading count and source order are not protected.

live_setting_facts: Live setting has a broad privacy rule: do not expose credentials, private endpoints, or secret material.
Targeted history mentions a past authentication incident and an unrelated credential type.
Current request asks for ordinary instruction cleanup, not new security policy.
expected: The historical incident does not create a new durable rule.
No new concrete credential/example list is added unless currently authorized.

live_setting_facts: The same mutable supported integration set appears in two live sections.
Future work only needs lookup-backed coverage, not member names before lookup.
expected: Both member enumerations are removed conceptually.
One lookup bridge covers all currently supported integrations defined by docs/current-integrations.md.
The same mutable set does not survive as an enumeration elsewhere.

allowed_meanings: All production mutations require explicit current-task authorization for object, purpose, and scope.
Client-profile changes require explicit current-task authorization.
live_broad_live_narrow.expected: The broad production authorization boundary survives; the narrow rule cannot swallow it.

allowed_meanings: Client-profile changes require explicit current-task authorization.
historical_broad_live_narrow.historical_only_absent_meaning: All production mutations require explicit current-task authorization for object, purpose, and scope.
historical_broad_live_narrow.expected: The historical-only broad rule is not resurrected; protected absence wins unless current user or authorized source sync re-adopts it.
